title: MT Schiff · Render Teil A (Maschinenraum, Kurbel, Propeller)

steps.label: stills
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/ship" && for s in sea_track sea_sunset port stern_prop holo_orbit; do /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P ship3d.py -- $s still 40 > st_$s.log 2>&1; grep -a "SHIP3D BUILT" st_$s.log | cut -c1-500; done; a=""; for f in st_*.jpg; do a="$a $f ship/st2/$f"; done; "$AGENT_HOME/node/bin/node" "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/push_preview.mjs" $a | tail -2

steps.label: r_crank_a
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/ship" && for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P ship3d.py -- crank_a render 100 >> r_crank_a.log 2>&1; grep -a "SHIP3D RENDERED" r_crank_a.log >/dev/null && break; sleep 3; done; ls r_crank_a | wc -l; cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -framerate 25 -i "$AGENT_HOME/work/ship/r_crank_a/f%04d.jpg" -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 21 -pix_fmt yuv420p "$AGENT_HOME/work/ship/crank_a.mp4" && cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/ship" && ls -l crank_a.mp4 && "$AGENT_HOME/node/bin/node" "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/push_preview.mjs" crank_a.mp4 ship/r3d/crank_a.mp4 | tail -1
